title: Remove watermarks and replace disclaimer text with ORDER NOW across all pages

requirements.text: Remove the global top banner text "Not valid for official identification" from all pages and replace it with "ORDER NOW" (English, all caps) in the same banner location so it appears consistently site-wide.

quotes: Remove all watermarks make sure they will stay gone on all pages also remove top Not valid for official identification and put ORDER NOW

acceptanceCriteria: On every route that uses the app shell header area, the top banner displays "ORDER NOW" and does not display "Not valid for official identification" anywhere in that banner.
No other page renders the previous top-banner disclaimer text (case-insensitive match).

requirements.text: Remove all instances of the disclaimer text "These identification cards are not valid for official identification or legal use. For informational purposes only." from the UI, including the landing page disclaimer block and any centralized copy constants that feed it.

quotes: also remove this These identification cards are not valid for official identification or legal use. For informational purposes only.

acceptanceCriteria: The landing page no longer renders the disclaimer block containing the exact sentence "These identification cards are not valid for official identification or legal use. For informational purposes only."
A text search through rendered UI strings shows the removed sentence is not present anywhere (including modals, banners, or notes).

requirements.text: Remove all instances of the order-form disclaimer text "Not valid for official identification or legal use." from the UI, including the New Order page info box and any centralized copy constants that feed it.

quotes: remove top Not valid for official identification
also remove this These identification cards are not valid for official identification or legal use. For informational purposes only.

acceptanceCriteria: The New Order page no longer displays the sentence "Not valid for official identification or legal use."
A text search through rendered UI strings shows "Not valid for official identification or legal use." is not present anywhere.

requirements.text: Update the ID card preview so the footer text "NOT VALID FOR OFFICIAL IDENTIFICATION" is removed and replaced with "ORDER NOW" (English, all caps) and ensure this change is reflected in on-screen preview, PNG export, and print output.

quotes: remove top Not valid for official identification and put ORDER NOW

acceptanceCriteria: The ID card preview footer shows "ORDER NOW" and does not show "NOT VALID FOR OFFICIAL IDENTIFICATION".
Exported PNG files do not contain the removed footer text and do contain "ORDER NOW".
The print view output does not contain the removed footer text and does contain "ORDER NOW".

requirements.text: Remove all watermarks from the application and ensure they stay removed across all pages and all ID output modes (preview, export PNG, print). This includes removing any watermark overlays/components and any CSS/DOM elements intended as watermarks.

quotes: Remove all watermarks make sure they will stay gone on all pages

acceptanceCriteria: No page renders any watermark text/graphics overlay in the UI (manual verification on Landing, Sign In, Dashboard, New Order, Order Detail, and Admin routes).
The ID card preview DOM does not include any watermark layer/component.
Exported PNG and printed ID do not include any watermark layer/graphics.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn components).
Keep changes limited to frontend; no backend schema/state changes are required for this request.
nonGoals: Adding new ordering/payment functionality beyond changing the displayed text to "ORDER NOW".
Changing routing/navigation behavior when users click buttons or banner text unless explicitly required by the request.
